title: pm daily scratchpad - console 2.0 launch tasks
content:
Day: 2026-03-10
Context: final prep for Console 2.0 soft launch (hosted API customers). Quick scratchpad - edits to PRD, stakeholder follow-ups, and launch checklist.

Top objectives for today:
- Lock PRD 'features & rollouts' section (need wording for canary vs full rollouts).
- Confirm infra autoscale policy with SRE + infra (latency SLOs and burst capacity).
- Final check on analytics events (usage, errors, fallback rates).
- Confirm docs + quickstart link live for beta customers.

PRD edits (actionable):
- Update rollout section to include explicit fallback policy: if p50 > 400ms or errors > 1% for 5m, then auto-fallback to previous model variant + notify on-call. (TODO: get wording sign-off from Samir)
- Add table mapping model variants to cost buckets (Samir to provide numbers from optimize team).
- Clarify canary audience gating: internal + 5 enterprise betas + 10% of production traffic (configurable). Need legal note re: data retention for beta.
- Add release checklist link -> Confluence page (linked_artifacts[1]) and embed quick command snippets for rollback.

Stakeholder follow-ups (who to ping):
- Jordan: confirm rollout email copy and customer comms cadence (pinged Slack #product-console at 09:05).
- Samir: need final quantized-model latency/cost table by EOD. (Samir slack DM)
- Priya (SRE): confirm autoscale policy + runbook (requested runbook v0.2).
- Legal: quick check on beta data retention policy (opened ticket CONSOLE-112).

Launch checklist (current status, checkboxes):
- [x] PRD draft ready (v0.9)
- [ ] PRD rollout section sign-off (owner: Aisha / reviewer: Samir)
- [ ] Autoscale policy defined and tested (owner: Priya / SRE)
- [ ] Canary config deployed to staging (owner: infra-release)
- [ ] Analytics events instrumented and validated (owner: analytics)
- [ ] Docs quickstart + migration guide published (owner: docs)
- [ ] Customer comms draft + approval (owner: Jordan)
- [ ] Final legal sign-off on beta data retention (owner: legal)
- [ ] Rollback playbook verified with SRE (owner: Priya)

Risks / open questions:
- Risk: model fallback may change latency profile for downstream integrations - need to update contract notes in docs.
- Risk: billing spike during canary if traffic distribution wrong; set alert on cost per minute.
- Question: should we include Dedicated customers in early canary? Pro: catches infra configs; Con: SLA differences. Need ops input.

Quick meeting notes (09:30 standup):
- Jordan: comms ready but wants one more change to tone for enterprise customers.
- Priya: autoscale test passed on 90% load simulation; one edge-case on KV cache warming - follow-up with infra team.
- Samir: cost estimates pending; expects numbers by EOD.

Next actions (this afternoon):
- 13:30 meet with SRE (Priya + infra) to finalize autoscale and rollback (calendar invite done).
- 15:00 review PRD final with Samir and Jordan - collect sign-offs.
- 16:30 smoke test canary in staging (coord with infra-release).
- Send consolidated daily update to stakeholders after 17:00 if checklist at >80% complete.

Notes to self:
- Keep PRD language concrete: avoid ambiguous words like 'low latency' - use ms numbers and percentiles.
- Save a copy of final PRD to Confluence + tag release branch PR.
- Remind docs to add a short troubleshooting section for 'KV cache warm-up' and 'fallback model artifacts'.

Misc quick links pasted here: CONSOLE-112 (jira), Console 2.0 Launch Plan (Confluence), PR #487 (console repo).

End of scratchpad.
